summary: Frontend-only verification of the new QRU Enterprise Manufacturing Dashboard™ (/knowledge-manufacturing) and Knowledge-Record inheritance into Poster Studio's QRU Knowledge Card™ template. All 6 review acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Persistent React hydration console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on data-testid='poster-template'. The emergent editor injects a <span style=display:contents data-ve-dynamic='true'> around dynamic <option> text; browsers strip it so functionality is unaffected. Cosmetic/console-only.

critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeManufacturing.js:22 & :32 use `.catch(() => {})` and `catch { /* ignore */ }` — silently swallow errors. Add at least console.error(e) for observability; a failing GET /media-studio/knowledge-manufacturing currently leaves the user staring at an empty page with no toast or diagnostic.
KnowledgeManufacturing.js:47 renders 35 KR buttons unpaginated inside a max-h-[640px] overflow container — fine for 35 but will become slow at 200+; consider a react-window/virtualised list.

manufacturing_dashboard.py:75 `state='published'` triggers on any status starting with PUBLISH or GOLD — that catches QRU_GOLD_STANDARD posters, but the state legend on the frontend only shows Published/Manufactured/Available. Confirm 'gold' tone chip labelled 'Published' is intentional for QRU_GOLD_STANDARD assets (currently no such asset in the seeded data so this branch is untested in UI).

manufacturing_dashboard.py:99 `kr_manufacturing_list` fetches 60 KRs then does 4× count_documents per KR sequentially (N+1 pattern) — for a large KR corpus this will be O(N) roundtrips. Consider an aggregation pipeline with $lookup or a single $facet.

kr_inheritance.py:57 tags dedup uses `dict.fromkeys` on the term with spaces removed then capitalised word tokens — for term 'Memory' the tags list becomes ['Memory','QRU','Verified'] which then gets each cleaned to /[^A-Za-z0-9]/ up to 16 chars — works, but if KR topic contains punctuation or unicode the tag becomes 'QRU' fallback; ensure UX shows at least one non-trivial tag.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing verified KRs: What Is Governance? (KMR-1A93CE v3) and What Is Memory? (KMR-8EEDA7 v2, id 8eeda74f-8f5e-4678-8458-d691b53877be).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 35 KR buttons present on /knowledge-manufacturing. On load, What Is Governance? auto-selects because it is the first verified KR in the list; its matrix shows Storyboard 5, Video 8, Audio 5, Presentation 7 (rest Available). Switching to What Is Memory? gives Knowledge Card 4, Storyboard 3, and Verify:VERIFIED_EXTERNAL on inherited Knowledge Card render. km-go-knowledge_card navigates to /poster-studio. In Poster Studio the knowledge-card-v1 template auto-forces `factual` on; entering the KR id 8eeda74f-... and clicking Manufacture yields DRAFT / Treasure:Passed / Verify:VERIFIED_EXTERNAL / Pre-Ship Gate 9/9 green with fully inherited content (term MEMORY, plain + professional definition, chart clue, real-life clues, memory sentence, tags) — no manual data was entered.
